title: Securitize Is Tokenization Provider as OKXICE Launches 24/7 Venue
summary: Securitize (NYSE: SECZ) is the tokenization provider for OKXICE's new 24/7 Tokenized Securities Venue, launched with 113 assets confirmed.
body_markdown:
As the venue's tokenization provider, Securitize brings its regulated securities infrastructure to support onchain trading, according to the company. Each token represents a security entitlement backed one-to-one by an underlying share, with applicable shareholder rights and economic benefits, including dividends, voting rights and corporate actions. The company's disclosures add that holders are not registered shareholders of the underlying issuer, and that economic benefits and voting entitlements are passed through subject to the governing terms.


Trading on the venue occurs through automated market maker (AMM) liquidity pools on Uniswap v4, built on X Layer, OKX's Ethereum Layer-2 network, and smart contracts limit trading to eligible wallets. The venue operates pursuant to the SEC's Innovation Exemption and is currently available to eligible U.S.-based OKX Inc. customers only.


## Why It Matters for SECZ


“Tokenization is moving beyond the issuance of securities onchain and into the infrastructure of how capital markets operate,” said Carlos Domingo, Chairman and CEO of Securitize. He called the launch “another important step toward markets that can operate around the clock while preserving the rights and protections investors expect.”
